_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Rank an app on keywords by country
_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Rank an app on keywords by country...

description: Use this when the user asks where an App Store app ranks for search phrases by country, or how much demand or competition a phrase has. Pass app (id or link), keywords (1 to 20) and countries (up to 10, default us). Per keyword and country: rank is the app's place in the iTunes Search API's top 200 (not_ranked past it, never guessed); volume 0-100 is the top 50 names' match to the phrase (whole phrase 1, else half the word share), summed over 50; difficulty 0-100 is the top 10 rating counts on a log scale (10 ratings 0, a million 1), summed over 10; weakMarket: not ranked while 10 other apps are. fetchedAt is the read time. A call waits about 8 s; cells not read by then are pending and keep being read: call again after retryAfterSeconds while pending falls. warnings says why reads fail.

app.description: The App Store app to rank, as an id or link, such as 1197354394.

countries.description: Up to 10 two-letter store countries, such as us, gb and jp. Default [us].

keywords.description: 1 to 20 search phrases as people type them in the App Store, such as photo editor.

name: app_tracker_keyword_rank

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

source.description: Who the data comes from, to cite and to check it against.

stoppedUntil.description: Set when the store answered 403 or 429, or failed 3 times in a row: no search is sent before this time.

warnings.description: Why cells are pending: the newest search failure of the last 10 minutes.

title: Rank an app on keywords by country
